snippet.title: Fractured in Alterac Valley Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Game Designers Cora and Liv provide an overview on what's new to Hearthstone with the latest card set, including the expansion-long Battle for Alterac event! Fractured in Alterac Valley will launch worldwide on December 7 with 135 new collectible cards, the new Honorable Kill keyword, Objective Spells, and Hero Cards for each Mercenary class character!

• Learn more about Fractured in Alterac Valley: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23746635 

• Read the 21.8 Patch Notes: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23746636
